title: In vitro and ex vivo evaluation of tumor-derived exosome-induced dendritic cell dysfunction in mouse
protocol: Culture tumor cells in RPMI 1640 media supplemented with 10% exosome-depleted FBS.
Collect supernatant of tumor cells after 48 h when cells reach 80% confluency.
Remove cell debris from tumor culture medium by centrifuging at 3,000 × g for 2 h at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatant to a sterile 100 kDa MWCO.
Centrifuge the supernatant at 3,000 × g for 30 min at 4°C to discard the fraction < 100 kDa.
Concentrate the remaining supernatant (usually 1.5 ml).
Store concentrated-supernatant at -80°C for up to 6 months until future use.
Transfer concentrated tumor culture supernatant to a sterile vessel.
Add 1/5 volume of ExoQuick-TC to the supernatant and mix well by inverting the tube.
Incubate the ExoQuick-TC/supernatant mixture at 4°C for 16–20 hours without rotating or mixing.
Centrifuge the ExoQuick-TC/supernatant mixture at 3,000 × g for 30 minutes.
Discard the supernatant and centrifuge again at 3,000 × g for 5 minutes to remove residual fluid.
Resuspend the exosome pellet with approximately 200 μL of 1× PBS.
Fix purified exosomes with 1 mL of 2% paraformaldehyde for 5 min.
Glow-discharge the thin formvar/carbon film coated grids for 1 min.
Load 5–7 μL exosome suspension (containing 50 μg exosomes) on the grid and incubate for 1 min.
Stain with filtered 1% uranyl acetate solution on the surface of grid.
Remove excess uranyl acetate with filter paper.
Rinse the grid with a drop of water to remove the excess staining solution.
Dry the grid for 10 min at 25°C.
Store the grid in a box for future observation by TEM at 80 kV.
Resuspend 0.2 mg exosome pellet in 200 μL RIPA buffer.
Vortex the mixture for 15 seconds.
Place the mixture on ice for 5 minutes to allow complete lysis.
Add 2× SDS buffer and heat at 95°C for 5 minutes.
Chill the sample on ice before loading onto the gel.
Perform standard SDS-PAGE electrophoresis.
Transfer the protein from the gel onto PVDF membrane.
Block the blot with 5% milk in Tris buffered saline + 0.05% Tween (TBST) for 1 hour.
Incubate the blot overnight at 4°C with exosome specific primary antibody at a dilution of 1:1,000 in 5% milk TBST.
Wash the blot three times with TBST.
Incubate the blot for 1 hour at 25°C with secondary antibody at a dilution of 1:1,500 in 5% milk TBST.
Wash the blot three times with TBST.
Incubate the blot with western blotting substrate and visualize on film.
Euthanize C57BL/6 mice (about 8–10 weeks of age).
Spray the euthanized mice with 75% ethanol.
Fix the mouse in a supine position.
Isolate entire leg bones from the mouse.
Carefully remove connective tissue and muscle from the bones.
Gently cut down the condyles of leg bones.
Infuse bone cavity with 1 mL RPMI medium (without FBS).
Flush out the bone marrow into a 10 cm cell culture dish.
Pass cells through a 70-μm cell strainer to prepare single-cell suspension.
Centrifuge at 500–600 × g for 5 min.
Discard supernatant from centrifuged cells.
Resuspend cells in 2 mL of 1× ACK lysis buffer.
Incubate the cells with ACK lysis buffer for 1 minute at 25°C.
Add 20 mL of RPMI medium containing 10% FBS to the cells.
Re-centrifuge the cells at 500–600 × g for 5 min.
Use lymphocyte gradient separation buffer to ensure the purity of DCs after wash.
Resuspend and count cells, then adjust cell suspension to 3 × 10^5 cells/mL with RPMI medium (10% FBS, 55 μM β-mercaptoethanol, 20 ng/mL rmGM-CSF, and 5 ng/mL rmIL-4).
Add 10 mL of adjusted cell suspension to a 10 cm cell culture dish.
Put the cells in a cell culture incubator.
Replenish 10 mL RPMI medium (10% FBS, 55 μM β-mercaptoethanol, 20 ng/mL rmGM-CSF, and 5 ng/mL rmIL-4) to the cells after three days.
Collect cells for further use six days after differentiation.
Discard adherent cells and only isolate suspended and loosely adherent cells for analysis.
Analyze DC phenotype by microscope and flow cytometry (MHC II+CD11c+).
Discard the supernatant, resuspend cells with 50 μL Fc blocker buffer, and mix well.
Incubate cells at 25°C for 5-10 min.
Add anti-mouse CD11c APC antibody and anti-mouse MHC II FITC to each tube and mix well.
Incubate cells at 4°C for 20 min.
Neutralize the reaction by adding extra 1 mL FACS buffer in each tube.
Centrifuge cells at 500-600 × g for 5 min at 4°C, discard supernatant, and resuspend cells for FACS analysis with DAPI.
Start with freshly isolated exosome pellets for TDEs treatment.
Resuspend exosome pellets in 500 μL Diluent C from PKH67 kit.
Add 3 μL PKH67 dye into another 500 μL tube of Diluent C.
Mix the resuspended exosomes and PKH67 continuously at 25°C for 5 minutes.
Neutralize the mixture by adding 1 mL of 10% sterile BSA solution.
Wash the PKH67-labeled exosomes twice with 1× sterile PBS.
Collect the PKH67-labeled TDEs by ultracentrifugation at 100,000 × g for 30 minutes at 25°C.
Resuspend the collected exosomes in 1× sterile PBS.
Treat BMDCs with 400 μg/mL of PKH67-labeled TDEs at 37°C for 6 hours.
Inject 1,000 μg of PKH67-labeled TDEs (in 50 μL 1×PBS) into the footpad of C57BL/6 mice under tribromo-ethanol anesthesia.
Anesthetize mice with 0.5 mL tribromo-ethanol by intraperitoneal injection.
Isolate lymph nodes from popliteal and inguinal regions at 48 hours post-injection.
Place a 70 μm cell strainer on top of a 50 mL centrifuge tube.
Grind isolated lymph nodes with a syringe plunger in the cell strainer.
Flush cells with 10 mL RPMI1640 (without FBS).
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 500-600 × g for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet with PBS (1% FBS) for staining.
Incubate cells in 50 μL Fc blocker buffer for 5-10 minutes at 25°C.
Add antibody mix to each tube and mix well.
Incubate the cells at 4°C for 20 minutes.
Neutralize the reaction by adding 1 mL FACS buffer to each tube.
Centrifuge the cells at 500-600 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cells in PBS (1% FBS) with DAPI (0.1 μg/mL).
Collect DCs by flow cytometry using markers CD45+, Ly6C−, MHC II+, F4/80−, CD11c+ PKH67+.
Incorporate B220 and CD14 in the ex vivo isolation to eliminate B220+ B cells and CD14high monocytes.
Anesthetize OTI transgenic mice by cervical dislocation.
Remove the spleen using tissue scissors and forceps.
Place the spleen on a 70 μm cell strainer over a 50 mL centrifuge tube.
Grind the spleen with a syringe plunger while flushing the strainer with 10 mL RPMI 1640 medium (without FBS).
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 500–600 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend cells in 3 mL of 1×RBC lysis buffer.
Incubate the RBC lysis process for 3-5 minutes with intermittent swirling.
Neutralize the RBC lysis by adding 30 mL RPMI 1640 medium (or HBSS) and mix well.
Pass the cell suspension through a 70 μm cell strainer again to exclude aggregates or clots.
Repeat centrifugation step: Centrifuge the cell suspension at 500–600 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant to obtain splenocytes.
Resuspend splenocytes in 1×Mojo buffer to achieve a cell density between 1×10^7–1×10^8 cells per mL.
Mix the resuspended cells well by pipetting several times.
Transfer the cells into a new sterile 5 mL round bottom tube (BD Falcon).
Add 10 μL Biotin-conjugated antibody cocktail per 100 μL of cells and mix well.
Incubate the cells with antibodies on ice for 15 min.
Add 10 μL nano-beads per 100 μL of cells and mix well.
Incubate the cells with antibodies on ice for another 15 min.
Add 2 mL 1×Mojo buffer to the tube.
Place the tube in the magnate to separate CD8+ T cells from other cell compartments by standing on the bench for 5 min at 25°C.
Pour out the un-attached cells and collect them in a 15 mL conical centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 500–600 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant after centrifugation.
Resuspend the isolated OT I CD8+ T cells with 50 μL Fc blocker buffer and mix well.
Incubate the cells at 25°C for 5–10 min.
Add 1/100 anti-mouse CD8a APC antibody and 1/100 anti-mouse TCRVa2 PE to each tube and mix well.
Incubate the cells at 4°C for 20 min.
Neutralize the reaction by adding extra 1 mL FACS buffer to each tube.
Centrifuge the cells at 500–600 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells for FACS analysis with 1/1000 DAPI (0.1 μg/mL) for separating live cells.
Resuspend the cells with 10 μM CFSE solution diluted in 1×PBS and mix well.
Incubate the cells at 25°C for 10 min in the dark.
Neutralize the CFSE labeling process by adding 0.2–0.5 mL FBS to the tube.
Centrifuge the cells at 500–600 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells by RPMI 1640 medium added with 10% FBS and 55 μM β-mercaptoethanol.
Count the cells.
Collect TDE-treated DCs as described in step 18 and step 21.
Treat 1×10^6 DCs with 2 mg/mL OVA antigen for 48 h (applicable for both in vitro or ex vivo treated DCs).
Collect and wash the cells by centrifuging at 500–600 × g for 5 min at 4°C to eliminate residual OVA antigen.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells with proper volume (200~400 μL) of RPMI 1640 medium added with 10% FBS and 55 μM β-mercaptoethanol.
Count the DCs.
Co-culture DCs and CFSE-labeled OTI CD8+ T cells at a ratio of 1:5 to 1:8.
Incubate the co-cultured cells for 4 days.
Centrifuge the collected cells at 500–600 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cells with 50 μL Fc blocker buffer.
Incubate the cells at 25°C for 5-10 minutes.
Add anti-mouse CD8 APC antibody, anti-mouse CD11c PE, and anti-mouse CD3 PE/Cy7 to each tube.
Mix well after adding antibodies.
Incubate the cells at 4°C for 20 minutes.
Neutralize the reaction by adding an extra 1 mL FACS buffer to each tube.
Centrifuge the cells at 500–600 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells for FACS analysis.
